hook: Your photo shows a wave frozen in stone.
title: Your photo shows a giant wave made of rock
description:
Wave Rock in Western Australia is a granite cliff about 14 metres high, shaped like a breaking ocean wave. It was carved by water and soil wearing away its base, not by the sea. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Australia #PlacesThatShouldntExist
